law: An evidence map, not a certificate: each row names the CI lane that actually proves it (the gates wall + the crashtest job in .github/workflows/test.yml), with the pinned tool that runs it. govstruct certifies nothing; this block only records what the battery measures.

gates.where: test.yml ci job - Run tests + Run standalone suites

gates.banner: the crashtest packs floor (contract table + real-harness run root)
packstruct author-time pack lint + the §7 conformance audit
eyestruct visual ledger gate (browserless, the meanings not the pixels)
poststruct shipped audit over the baked home dist

the dependency ledger census (depstruct: the never-add-deps law — every declared dep rides a ledger row, a lane's evidence, the family pin, and lockfile parity; cross-checks the pins this map records)
gates.where: test.yml ci job - Dependency ledger census

gates.banner: this family's own identity + conformance (the manifest you are reading's gate)
gates.where: test.yml ci job - govstruct identity gate
